image_prompts: A white porcelain bathtub filled with warm water and white foam bubbles, a rubber duck floating on the surface, soft steam rising in a clean bathroom with blue tiles.
A wooden bathtub in a natural hot spring setting, surrounded by smooth stones and green bamboo leaves, clear water reflecting the sky.
words.image_desc_en: A bathtub with foam and a rubber duck; a wooden bathtub in a hot spring.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个带泡沫和橡皮鸭的浴缸；一个在温泉中的木制浴缸。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，常用单数形式，如 take a bath / have a bath)
words.collocations: take a bath, have a bath, hot bath, bubble bath
words.preposition_combos: in the bath, after a bath

examples.en: After the long run, I took a hot bath to relax.
examples.cn: 长跑之后，我洗了个热水澡来放松。

examples.en: My cat always sits outside the bathroom when I have a bath.
examples.cn: 我洗澡时，我的猫总是坐在浴室外面。

socratic_questions.question: 你运动完一身汗，回家后最想做什么来清洁身体、放松肌肉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指在浴缸里泡水清洁，不是淋浴，也不是游泳。

sentences: After the camping trip, everyone needed a hot ___ to get clean.

image_prompts: A calendar with a red circle around a past date, a wilted flower placed on the desk next to it, soft morning light through a window.
An empty chair at a dining table with a single plate and a cup of cold tea, a clock showing late evening.
words.image_desc_en: A calendar with a circled date and a wilted flower; an empty chair at a table with cold tea.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张日历上圈着日期并放着一朵枯萎的花；餐桌旁一把空椅子和冷茶。
words.usage: v. (过去式 missed, 过去分词 missed)
words.collocations: miss the bus, miss a chance, miss someone, miss a goal
words.preposition_combos: miss out on, miss by (e.g., miss by one point)

examples.en: I missed the early bus and had to walk to school.
examples.cn: 我错过了早班公交车，不得不步行去学校。

examples.en: She misses her best friend who moved to another city.
examples.cn: 她想念搬到另一个城市的最好的朋友。

socratic_questions.question: 你早上起晚了，跑到车站时公交车刚好开走，你没能赶上它，用哪个词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示没能赶上或没能抓住，也用于表达思念某人。

sentences: If you run fast, you won't ___ the last train.

image_prompts: A stack of identical textbooks piled high on a desk, a clock showing late night, a half-empty coffee cup with cold liquid.
A treadmill with a worn-out belt and dust on the display screen, a wilted plant in the corner of a gym.
words.image_desc_en: A tall stack of textbooks with a late-night clock and cold coffee; a dusty treadmill with a wilted plant.
words.image_desc_cn: 一摞高高的教科书、深夜的钟和冷咖啡；一台布满灰尘的跑步机和枯萎的植物。
words.usage: 短语动词 (be tired of + n./doing)
words.collocations: be tired of waiting, be tired of the same food, be tired of homework
words.preposition_combos: tired of (后接名词或动名词)

examples.en: I am tired of eating noodles for breakfast every day.
examples.cn: 我厌倦了每天早餐吃面条。

examples.en: The class is tired of the same math exercises every week.
examples.cn: 全班都厌倦了每周做同样的数学练习。

socratic_questions.question: 你连续一周每天吃同样的午餐，现在看到那个饭盒就觉得没胃口，你是什么感觉？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语表示因为重复或太久而产生厌烦情绪，不是身体累，而是心理上不想再继续。

sentences: After three hours of waiting, the children ___ ___ ___ the long line.

image_prompts: A small sapling growing out of a crack in a concrete pavement, sunlight shining on its green leaves, showing strength and possibility.
A completed 1000-piece jigsaw puzzle on a wooden table, the last piece being placed into the center, a magnifying glass nearby.
words.image_desc_en: A sapling growing through concrete; a completed jigsaw puzzle with the last piece being placed.
words.image_desc_cn: 一棵从混凝土裂缝中长出的小树苗；一幅完成的拼图，最后一块正在放入。
words.usage: adj. (常用 be able to do sth.)
words.collocations: be able to do, able to finish, able to solve

examples.en: With enough practice, you will be able to play the piano well.
examples.cn: 通过足够的练习，你将能够弹好钢琴。

examples.en: She was able to finish the test before the bell rang.
examples.cn: 她能够在铃响前完成测试。

socratic_questions.question: 你经过一个月的练习，终于可以连续跳绳100次而不中断，你具备了这种能力，用哪个词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示具备做某事的能力或条件，后面常跟 to do。

sentences: With the new map app, we were ___ to find the museum easily.

image_prompts: A wooden stick lying on a pile of autumn leaves, sunlight filtering through trees
A glue stick half-used on a white desk next to a torn piece of paper
words.image_desc_en: A wooden stick on autumn leaves; a glue stick on a desk with torn paper.
words.image_desc_cn: 一根木棍躺在秋叶堆上；一支用了一半的胶棒放在白色桌面上，旁边有撕破的纸。
words.meaning_cn: v. 粘贴；卡住；坚持 n. 棍子；枝条
words.usage: v. (过去式 stuck, 过去分词 stuck) / n. (可数名词)
words.collocations: stick to, stick with, stick out, glue stick
words.preposition_combos: stick to (坚持/粘在), stick in (卡在), stick on (贴在)

examples.en: I stuck a note on the fridge for my mom.
examples.cn: 我在冰箱上贴了一张便条给妈妈。

examples.en: The key stuck in the lock and would not move.
examples.cn: 钥匙卡在锁里动不了了。

socratic_questions.question: 你想把一张照片贴到日记本上，需要用什么动作？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动作表示用胶水或胶带固定，不是钉或夹。

sentences: The stamp won't ___ on the envelope because it's wet.

image_prompts: A daily planner with a red pen marking each completed task, a coffee cup beside it
A running track with white lane lines and a pair of worn running shoes at the start line
words.image_desc_en: A planner with red checkmarks and a coffee cup; a track with lane lines and worn shoes.
words.image_desc_cn: 一本计划表上红色笔勾出已完成任务，旁边有咖啡杯；一条跑道上有白色分道线和一双旧跑鞋。
words.meaning_cn: 坚持（做某事）；遵守（计划、原则等）
words.usage: 动词短语 (过去式 stuck to, 过去分词 stuck to)
words.collocations: stick to a plan, stick to a diet, stick to the rules
words.preposition_combos: stick to (后接名词或动名词)

examples.en: You should stick to your study plan every day.
examples.cn: 你应该每天坚持你的学习计划。

examples.en: He stuck to his decision even when others disagreed.
examples.cn: 即使别人不同意，他也坚持自己的决定。

socratic_questions.question: 你定了一个每天背20个单词的计划，但第三天就想放弃。你需要做什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语强调不改变、不放弃，和‘坚持’意思一样。

sentences: If you want to improve your English, you must ___ your daily practice.

image_prompts: A calendar on a wall with January 1 circled in red and a list of goals written below
A notebook open to a page with bullet points: 'Exercise 3 times a week, Read 2 books a month'
words.image_desc_en: A wall calendar with Jan 1 circled and a goal list; a notebook with bullet-pointed goals.
words.image_desc_cn: 墙上日历中1月1日被红笔圈出，下方列着目标清单；一本笔记本上写着要点式目标。
words.usage: n. (可数名词，复数 resolutions)
words.collocations: make a resolution, New Year's resolution, keep a resolution
words.preposition_combos: resolution to do sth, resolution about sth

examples.en: My New Year's resolution is to exercise more often.
examples.cn: 我的新年决心是多锻炼。

examples.en: She made a resolution to finish her homework before dinner.
examples.cn: 她下定决心在晚饭前完成作业。

socratic_questions.question: 新年到了，你决定今年要早睡早起。这个决定叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词常和‘新年’搭配，表示一个正式或郑重的决定。

sentences: Tom made a ___ to save money for a new bike.

image_prompts: A kitchen table with a plate of pancakes, a glass of orange juice, and a fork
A bookshelf filled with colorful books, a small globe on the shelf edge
words.image_desc_en: A table with pancakes and orange juice; a bookshelf with books and a globe.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张餐桌上有煎饼和橙汁；一个书架上摆满彩色书籍，边缘放着小地球仪。
words.meaning_cn: v. 有；拥有；吃；喝；进行（活动）
words.usage: v. (过去式 had, 过去分词 had; 第三人称单数 has)
words.collocations: have breakfast, have a good time, have a test, have to
words.preposition_combos: have + 名词（无固定介词搭配，但常接 for + 餐名）

examples.en: We usually have lunch at twelve o'clock.
examples.cn: 我们通常十二点吃午饭。

examples.en: She has a new bicycle that her parents gave her.
examples.cn: 她有一辆父母给她的新自行车。

socratic_questions.question: 你早上饿了，想描述你吃了面包和牛奶，该用哪个动词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个动词既可以表示‘拥有’，也可以表示‘吃/喝’。

sentences: I usually ___ a glass of milk before going to bed.

image_prompts: A whiteboard with a large goal written at the top and three smaller checkboxes labeled Step 1, Step 2, Step 3 below it, marker lines connecting them
A staircase made of wooden blocks, each block labeled with a small task like 'read 10 pages' and a tiny flag on the top block
words.image_desc_en: A whiteboard with a large goal at the top and three smaller checkboxes labeled Step 1, Step 2, Step 3 below, connected by marker lines.
words.image_desc_cn: 一块白板，顶部写有大目标，下方有三个标有步骤1、2、3的小复选框，用马克笔线条连接。
words.usage: 名词 n. (可数，复数 mini-goals)
words.collocations: set a mini-goal, achieve a mini-goal, break into mini-goals

examples.en: I set a mini-goal to finish my math homework before dinner.
examples.cn: 我设定了一个小目标，在晚饭前完成数学作业。

examples.en: Breaking a big task into mini-goals makes it easier to start.
examples.cn: 把大任务分解成小目标会让开始变得更容易。

socratic_questions.question: 你想提高英语成绩，但觉得背100个单词太难了。如果先只背10个，这10个单词可以叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词由“迷你”和“目标”组成，表示一个很小的、容易完成的目标。

sentences: To finish the project on time, we should break it into several ___.

image_prompts: A gold trophy sitting on a wooden podium with a red ribbon tied around its base, soft spotlight from above
A stack of books with a graduation cap on top, a certificate leaning against the books
words.image_desc_en: A gold trophy on a wooden podium with a red ribbon, lit by a soft spotlight from above.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个金色奖杯放在木质领奖台上，底座系着红丝带，上方有柔和的聚光灯。
words.usage: 动词 v. (过去式 achieved, 过去分词 achieved)
words.collocations: achieve a goal, achieve success, achieve a dream

examples.en: She worked hard to achieve her dream of winning the race.
examples.cn: 她努力实现了赢得比赛的梦想。

examples.en: You can achieve good grades if you study every day.
examples.cn: 如果你每天学习，就能取得好成绩。

socratic_questions.question: 你每天练习弹钢琴，最后终于能在音乐会上演奏一首完整的曲子。这个结果可以用哪个词描述？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示通过努力最终成功完成某件事，常和“目标”“梦想”搭配。

sentences: With enough practice, you can ___ anything you set your mind to.

image_prompts: A set of dumbbells and a yoga mat on a wooden floor, a water bottle beside them
A bicycle parked next to a running track with white lane markings, morning sunlight
words.image_desc_en: A set of dumbbells and a yoga mat on a wooden floor with a water bottle beside them.
words.image_desc_cn: 一组哑铃和一张瑜伽垫放在木地板上，旁边有一个水瓶。
words.usage: 形容词 adj. (副词形式 physically)
words.collocations: physical health, physical activity, physical education

examples.en: Doing physical exercise every morning helps me stay healthy.
examples.cn: 每天早上做体育锻炼有助于我保持健康。

examples.en: The school has a new gym for physical education classes.
examples.cn: 学校有一个新的体育馆用于体育课。

socratic_questions.question: 老师让你多运动，比如跑步、游泳，这些和身体有关的活动可以用哪个形容词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词和“身体”有关，常用来描述运动、健康或体力活动。

sentences: Regular ___ activity can improve your mood and energy levels.

image_prompts: A fresh green salad in a white bowl with cherry tomatoes and cucumber slices, natural light
A glass of water and an apple on a wooden table next to a small potted plant
words.image_desc_en: A fresh green salad in a white bowl with cherry tomatoes and cucumber slices under natural light.
words.image_desc_cn: 一碗新鲜绿色沙拉放在白色碗里，有樱桃番茄和黄瓜片，在自然光下。
words.usage: 名词 n. (不可数；形容词形式 healthy)
words.collocations: good health, in poor health, health problem, health care

examples.en: Eating fruits and vegetables is important for your health.
examples.cn: 吃水果和蔬菜对你的健康很重要。

examples.en: The doctor gave us some advice about keeping good health.
examples.cn: 医生给了我们一些关于保持良好健康的建议。

socratic_questions.question: 你最近总是熬夜，妈妈很担心你的身体状态。她担心的是你的什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词指身体没有生病、状态良好的情况，常和“保持”“关心”搭配。

sentences: Drinking enough water every day is good for your ___.

image_prompts: A wooden cutting board with fresh vegetables and a glass of water, bright natural light from a window
A bowl of oatmeal topped with berries and nuts on a white tablecloth, steam rising gently
words.image_desc_en: A wooden cutting board with fresh vegetables and a glass of water, bright natural light from a window
words.image_desc_cn: 一块木砧板上放着新鲜蔬菜和一杯水，明亮的自然光从窗户照入
words.usage: adv. (副词，由形容词 healthy + -ly 构成)
words.collocations: eat healthily, live healthily, grow healthily

examples.en: To pass the exam, you should eat healthily and sleep well.
examples.cn: 为了通过考试，你应该健康饮食并睡好觉。

examples.en: The plants in the garden grow healthily under the warm sun.
examples.cn: 花园里的植物在温暖的阳光下健康生长。

socratic_questions.question: 小明最近总吃炸鸡和薯条，你觉得他这样饮食方式对身体好吗？应该用什么词来描述正确的饮食方式？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词强调“以健康的方式”，不是单纯说“健康”这个状态，而是修饰动作“吃”。

sentences: My grandmother always tells me to eat ___ and exercise every day.

image_prompts: A pair of running shoes placed on a gym floor next to a water bottle, laces untied
An open guitar case on a wooden floor with a guitar leaning inside, sheet music nearby
words.meaning_cn: 开始从事（某项活动或爱好）
words.usage: v. (动词短语，过去式 took up, 过去分词 taken up)
words.collocations: take up a hobby, take up a sport, take up photography
words.preposition_combos: take up + 名词（活动/爱好）

examples.en: I plan to take up swimming this summer to get stronger.
examples.cn: 我计划今年夏天开始学游泳来变得更强壮。

examples.en: She decided to take up painting after visiting the art museum.
examples.cn: 参观艺术博物馆后，她决定开始学绘画。

socratic_questions.question: 你的朋友最近觉得放学后很无聊，想学点新东西，比如弹吉他或打篮球。你会建议他“开始做”哪件事？用什么短语表达“开始做”这个意思？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语由两个词组成，表示“开始从事一项新的活动”，不是“拿起”物品的意思。

sentences: My brother wants to ___ a new hobby like playing the piano.

image_prompts: A vintage camera on a wooden table with a roll of film and a developed photo showing a landscape
A close-up of a camera lens reflecting a sunset sky, with a blurred background of trees
words.usage: n. (不可数名词)
words.collocations: digital photography, wildlife photography, photography club
words.preposition_combos: in photography, photography of + 对象

examples.en: Our school photography club meets every Friday afternoon in Room 201.
examples.cn: 我们学校摄影社每周五下午在201教室活动。

examples.en: He showed us his photography of the mountains during the trip.
examples.cn: 他向我们展示了旅行中拍摄的山景照片。

socratic_questions.question: 学校要办一个社团展览，你想展示用相机拍下的校园美景。这个用相机记录画面的活动叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词以 -graphy 结尾，指的是“用相机拍摄照片的艺术或活动”，不是指相机本身。

sentences: I joined the school ___ club to learn how to take better pictures.

image_prompts: An open notebook on a desk with a pen and a list titled 'Goals', a small plant beside it
A stack of books on a shelf with titles like 'Learn New Skills' and 'Be Better', soft lamp light
words.usage: n. (不可数名词，由 self- + improvement 构成)
words.collocations: self-improvement plan, self-improvement book, focus on self-improvement

examples.en: Reading books every day is a great way for self-improvement.
examples.cn: 每天读书是自我提升的好方法。

examples.en: She made a self-improvement plan to learn English and exercise more.
examples.cn: 她制定了一个自我提升计划，包括学英语和多锻炼。

socratic_questions.question: 你想在新学期让自己变得更好，比如提高成绩、学会新技能。这种让自己进步的过程叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词由“自己”和“改进”两个部分合成，强调个人主动让自己变得更好，不是别人帮你。

sentences: Setting small goals every week helps with ___.

image_prompts: A neatly stacked pile of exam papers with a red A+ mark on top, bright sunlight streaming across the desk
A microphone standing alone on an empty stage with a single spotlight shining down, no person visible
words.image_desc_en: A pile of exam papers with a red A+ mark on top, bright sunlight on a desk
words.image_desc_cn: 一叠考试卷，最上面一张有红色A+标记，明亮的阳光照在书桌上
words.usage: adj. (比较级 more confident, 最高级 most confident; 副词 confidently)
words.collocations: feel confident, be confident about, confident smile

examples.en: She felt confident before the math exam because she studied hard.
examples.cn: 她在数学考试前感到自信，因为她努力学习。

examples.en: A confident speaker uses clear words and a strong voice.
examples.cn: 自信的演讲者使用清晰的词语和有力的声音。

socratic_questions.question: 小明复习了整整一周，走进考场时心里很踏实，觉得自己一定能考好。这种心态用一个形容词怎么描述？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示对自己能力有把握、不紧张，和‘相信’有关。

sentences: She is ___ that she can finish the project on time.

image_prompts: A stack of colorful sticky notes on a whiteboard, each labeled with a different adjective like 'big', 'small', 'bright'
An open dictionary page with the word 'adjective' highlighted in yellow, surrounded by grammar symbols
words.image_desc_en: A collection of sticky notes with adjective examples on a whiteboard, and a dictionary page highlighting the word 'adjective'.
words.image_desc_cn: 白板上贴满写有形容词例子的彩色便签，以及一本打开词典中高亮显示“形容词”一词的页面。
words.usage: adj. (adjective) 形容词，用于修饰名词或代词，表示性质、特征等。
words.collocations: adjective + noun; be + adjective

examples.en: The word 'happy' is an adjective that describes a feeling.
examples.cn: 单词“happy”是一个描述感觉的形容词。

examples.en: In the sentence, 'a red apple', 'red' is an adjective.
examples.cn: 在句子“a red apple”中，“red”是一个形容词。

socratic_questions.question: 在英语中，我们常用一类词来修饰名词，比如“a beautiful flower”中的“beautiful”。这类词叫什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这类词用来描述人或事物的性质、特征，答案就是“形容词”。

sentences: In grammar, 'big' is an ___ that describes size.

image_prompts: A neatly arranged desk with color-coded folders, labeled binders, and a tidy pencil holder
A calendar on a wall with each day filled in different colors, showing a structured weekly schedule
words.image_desc_en: A clean desk with color-coded folders and binders, and a wall calendar with a structured weekly schedule.
words.image_desc_cn: 一张整洁的桌子，上面有颜色分类的文件夹和活页夹，以及墙上显示结构化周计划的日历。
words.usage: adj. (organized) 形容人或事物安排有序、系统化。动词原形：organize (v.)；过去式/过去分词：organized (v.)；名词：organization (n.)
words.collocations: well-organized; organized person; organized event

examples.en: She keeps her schoolbag very organized with separate folders.
examples.cn: 她用分开的文件夹把书包整理得很有条理。

examples.en: An organized study plan helps you prepare for exams.
examples.cn: 有条理的学习计划有助于你准备考试。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的书桌很乱，找不到笔和书，而同桌的书桌每样东西都放得整整齐齐，你会怎么形容同桌？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个词表示“有条理的”，形容做事或物品摆放很有秩序。

sentences: A ___ student always finishes homework on time.

image_prompts: A piggy bank with a few coins next to a calculator, symbolizing saving money carefully

examples.cn: 最后但同样重要的是，我们应该记得回收塑料瓶。

examples.en: Last but not least, the blue team gave an excellent performance in the game.
examples.cn: 最后但同样重要的是，蓝队在比赛中表现出色。

socratic_questions.question: 你在总结发言时，想强调最后一个要点和前面的同样重要，该用什么短语开头？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这个短语以‘最后’开头，但强调‘不次要’，常用于列举的结尾。

sentences: ___, we must not forget to turn off the lights before leaving.
